import torch, math
import torch.nn.functional as F
dev='cuda'
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False
def gen(B,C,H,W,seed):
    g=torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(seed)
    r=lambda *s: torch.randn(*s,generator=g,device=dev,dtype=torch.float32)
    x=r(B,C,H,W); dww=r(C,1,7,7)/math.sqrt(7); dwb=r(C)
    lnw=torch.ones(C,device=dev); lnb=torch.zeros(C,device=dev)
    w1=r(4*C,C)/math.sqrt(C); b1=r(4*C)
    gw=r(1,1,1,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C); gb=r(1,1,1,4*C)
    w2=r(C,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C); b2=r(C)
    return x,dww,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2
f16=lambda t: t.float().half().double()
def run(B,C,H,W,seed,atol):
    x,dww,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2=gen(B,C,H,W,seed)
    D=lambda t:t.double()
    X=D(x); HW=H*W; M=B*HW; C4=4*C
    d=F.conv2d(X,D(dww),D(dwb),padding=3,groups=C)
    a=F.layer_norm(d.permute(0,2,3,1),(C,),D(lnw),D(lnb),1e-6)
    h=a@D(w1).T+D(b1); h=0.5*h*(1+torch.erf(h/math.sqrt(2)))
    gx=torch.norm(h,p=2,dim=(1,2),keepdim=True); nx=gx/(gx.mean(dim=-1,keepdim=True)+1e-6)
    hh=D(gw)*(h*nx)+D(gb)+h
    ref=(X+(hh@D(w2).T+D(b2)).permute(0,3,1,2)).reshape(B,C,HW)
    # emulation
    d16=f16(d); dt=d16.permute(0,2,3,1).reshape(M,C)
    mu=dt.mean(1); var=(dt*dt).mean(1)-mu*mu; rs=1/torch.sqrt(var+1e-6)
    W1p=f16(w1*lnw[None,:]); u=W1p.sum(1); v=D(w1)@D(lnb)+D(b1)
    z=rs[:,None]*(dt@W1p.T-mu[:,None]*u[None,:])+v[None,:]
    g=0.5*z*(1+torch.erf(z/math.sqrt(2)))
    g=g.reshape(B,HW,C4)
    gf=torch.sqrt((g*g).sum(1)); s=1+D(gw).reshape(1,C4)*gf/(gf.mean(1,keepdim=True)+1e-6)  # B,C4
    h16=f16(g)
    b2p=(D(w2)@D(gb).reshape(C4)+D(b2))
    W2=D(w2)
    out={}
    hs=h16*s[:,None,:]
    out['P0 fp16(W2*s).h16']=torch.einsum('btk,bck->bct',h16,f16(W2[None]*s[:,None,:].float().double()))
    out['P1 fp16(W2).fp16(h16*s)']=torch.einsum('btk,ck->bct',f16(hs),f16(W2))
    out['P2 fp16(fp16(W2)*s).h16']=torch.einsum('btk,bck->bct',h16,f16(f16(W2)[None]*s[:,None,:]))
    hi=f16(hs); lo=f16(hs-hi)
    out['P3 hilo B']=torch.einsum('btk,ck->bct',hi+lo,f16(W2))
    res=[]
    for k,y in out.items():
        o=X.reshape(B,C,HW)+y+b2p[None,:,None]
        e=(o-ref).abs(); bad=(e>atol+1e-5*ref.abs()).sum().item()
        res.append(f"{k}: max {e.max().item():.3e} ({e.max().item()/atol*100:.0f}%) rms {e.pow(2).mean().sqrt().item():.2e} beyond {bad}")
    return res
for (B,C,H,W,atol) in [(8,320,32,32,2.4e-3),(4,96,56,56,2.8e-3)]:
    for seed in range(4):
        print(B,C,seed,*run(B,C,H,W,seed,atol),sep='\n  ')
